Job Title : SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect

Experience : 6+ Years

Work Location : Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune

Notice Period : Immediate to 30 Days

Travel : Short-term, frequent travel to the USA for project deployment

Company Overview

GyanSys is a global mid-tier systems integrator with over 20 years of experience, headquartered in the United States. With 3,000+ employees across 12 countries, the company serves over 160 active enterprise customers across Manufacturing, Industrial, Consumer, Life Sciences, and High-Tech industries. GyanSys delivers digital transformation services through SAP, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, application modernization, and AI-led initiatives.

Job Summary

GyanSys is seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect with 6+ years of experience and at least one hands-on S/4HANA Finance transformation project. The candidate will be responsible for leading the design, architecture, and end-to-end implementation of enterprise finance solutions across core SAP Finance, Financial Supply Chain Management (FSCM), and Controlling and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA). The ideal candidate should possess strong functional and architectural expertise in SAP FICO, FSCM, CO-PA, and cross-module integration. This role requires hands-on configuration experience, the ability to lead business workshops, and expertise in translating complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the architecture, design, and end-to-end implementation of SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation projects.
• Design and govern finance solutions across General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, and Financial Closing.
• Architect and configure SAP FSCM components, including Credit Management, Collections Management, Dispute Management, Treasury, and Bank Communication.
• Design and implement SAP CO-PA solutions covering both Costing-Based and Account-Based Profitability Analysis.
• Define profitability analysis models, value fields, characteristics, and enterprise reporting structures.
• Drive cross-module integration architecture across SAP FICO, CO-PA, FSCM, SD, MM, and PS.
• Lead blueprinting workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and fit-gap analysis with business and finance stakeholders.
• Translate business requirements into functional architecture, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps.
• Establish architectural governance, configuration standards, and best practices for SAP Finance solutions.
• Guide technical teams on interfaces, enhancements, data migration, integrations, and reporting requirements.
• Ensure seamless financial and operational reporting across the SAP landscape.
• Support testing, deployment, issue resolution, and post-implementation activities.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in SAP Finance / SAP FICO.
• At least one hands-on SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation or implementation project.
• Experience working as a Solution Architect or leading solution design and architecture activities.
• Strong hands-on configuration expertise across GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, and Financial Closing.
• Expertise in SAP FSCM, including Credit Management, Collections Management, Dispute Management, and Treasury/Bank Communication.
• Strong experience in SAP CO-PA, covering Costing-Based and Account-Based approaches.
• Knowledge of profitability models, value fields, characteristics, and reporting structures.
• Proven experience in cross-module integration across FICO, CO-PA, FSCM, SD, MM, and PS.
• Experience leading blueprinting, business requirement gathering, and fit-gap analysis.
• Ability to guide technical teams on integrations, enhancements, data migration, and reporting.

Good To Have

• Experience in global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
• Exposure to enterprise finance architecture and process standardization.
• Experience working with international stakeholders and distributed teams.
• Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Requirements

• Work Location : Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Pune.
• Notice Period : Immediate joiners to candidates serving up to 30 days.
• Willingness to travel frequently for short-term project deployments in the USA.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to join our Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) team within Finance. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

• Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.

• Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.

• Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.

• NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.

• Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.

• Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.

• Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.

• Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.

• Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

• Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.

• Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.

• Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.

• Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.

• Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.

• People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

Manager, Accounting

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven Manager, Accounting to lead and manage the accounting operations within our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of accounting activities, supporting both corporate and statutory reporting requirements.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting operations, a proven ability to manage teams, and experience working in a fast-paced, global environment. This position requires a hands-on approach to managing processes, resolving issues timely, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and invest in to ensure operational excellence with a highly customer centric approach.
Role & Responsibilities:
Accounting Operations Management:
• Oversee the day-to-day accounting operations, including cash reconciliation, general ledger management, month-end and year-end close processes, reconciling cash and cash equivalent accounts, effective monitoring of control accounts and variance analysis of periodic movements around our diverse global cash operations.
• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and corporate policies.
• Manage the preparation and review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations.
Collaborate closely with Treasury and cross-functional teams to drive the accurate and efficient management of cash operations

Financial Reporting & Compliance:
• Support audit requirements.
• Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial and operational reports, balance sheet disclosures/footnotes, meeting internal and external deadlines.
• Maintain a robust internal control framework to mitigate risks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership & Development:
• Able to lead, mentor and motivate a team of accounting professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
• Able to provide coaching and development opportunities to enhance team members' technical and leadership skills.
• Allocate tasks effectively, ensuring team efficiency and alignment with organizational priorities.

Process Improvement & Optimization:
• Identify and implement process improvements to streamline workflows, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency in accounting operations.
• Leverage technology and automation tools, to optimize accounting processes.
• Drive standardization of accounting practices across multiple entities and regions.
• Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Partner with cross-functional teams, including Treasury, Corporate Controllership, to support business needs and strategic initiatives.
• Communicate effectively with senior management, providing insights into accounting operations and key financial metrics.
• Address escalations from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

All About You:
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, or equivalent certification preferred.
• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years in a SME/lead role.
• Strong understanding of subledger and controlling accounts for AP, AR, Intercompany etc
• Strong technical expertise in accounting operations, including GL management, reconciliations, and close processes.
• In-depth knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, and statutory reporting requirements.
• Proficiency in Oracle systems is must
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong commitment to customer service excellence, featuring a customer-centric mindset
• Thorough understanding of MS Excel (Knowledge in PowerBI/Power Automate is beneficial)
• Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
